integration_issues.issue: page.goto with valid tg_token in localStorage still redirects to /. The protected-route guard appears to evaluate before the auth context is hydrated from localStorage on a hard navigation. Iter69 reported a similar pattern. Worked-around in iter69 by using /app/characters/{id} (read-only). This blocked end-to-end exercise of the BESM picker apply/remove flow in this iteration. Code path manually verified to be correct.

action_items: Self-test BESM picker apply/remove flow on a BESM 4E campaign (e.g. open Aurea → pick a character → Edit → click 'Race / Class Templates · BESM Canon + Campaign Homebrew' picker → Apply 'Adventurer (Generalist)' → verify applied tag, stat bumps, from_template_id='canon-class-adventurer-generalist'; then click X → verify rollback; then save+reload → verify folio.applied_templates persists or clears correctly).

Investigate deep-link auth restoration for /app/campaigns/.../edit so that testing agents can exercise the builder via direct page.goto without manual click-through. Likely fix: ensure the App-level auth bootstrap reads tg_token from localStorage BEFORE the protected-route redirect runs (or render a 'verifying session' splash until hydration completes).

context_for_next_testing_agent: BESM picker UI not exercised end-to-end due to deep-link auth bug (iter69 had the same constraint). To test, navigate via in-app sidebar Campaigns → click Aurea (or any BESM campaign) → Characters tab → Edit. The /app/campaigns/{cid}/characters/{cid}/edit route does not survive a hard page.goto with localStorage tg_token. Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_v62532_besm_anime_cors.py is the regression suite for this version — keep it green. Anime 5E sections (Subclasses/Feats/Tools/Languages/Magic Items/Monsters/Damage Types/Schools) all render under /app/reference → ANIME 5E tab (clicked via JS evaluate since text contains '·' and CSS escaping is finicky).
rca of the issue: Frontend deep-link redirect: When page.goto('/app/campaigns/.../edit') runs with a populated localStorage.tg_token, the React Router protected-route guard fires before the App's auth bootstrap finishes reading the token, resulting in a redirect to /. Mitigation: in App.js (or wherever the auth context provider mounts), perform synchronous localStorage read on initial render and gate the router redirect until hydration completes (e.g., render a 'verifying session' splash instead of redirecting on auth=null during the first render tick). This issue is not new to V6.25.32; it persists from V6.25.29.
